llm_response.reason: The website exhibits numerous scam indicators: (1) heavy mimicry of Lazada (a credible e-commerce brand), (2) mixing of unrelated business types (gambling and e-commerce), (3) excessive discounts (up to -95%) and urgent calls to action, (4) hyperlinks redirect all major functions (login, registration, bonus, support) to a different, unrelated domain (uchiha-itachi.site), and (5) ambiguous company identity and unverified customer service info. These traits align with multiple scam criteria: spoofing, unrealistic offers, broad product range, and deceptive redirects.
